mutations.name: an enqueue does not pump the queue
kills: the push dispatcher starts reviews from the one queue on its three triggers starts a review on enqueue when the machine has room, with no wait

mutations.name: a review ending does not wake the dispatcher
kills: the push dispatcher starts reviews from the one queue on its three triggers starts exactly the queue's front when a review ends and frees the slot

mutations.name: the tick does not pump the queue
kills: the push dispatcher starts reviews from the one queue on its three triggers starts exactly the queue's front on the tick once the machine settles, and nothing between ticks

mutations.name: the dispatcher's order keeps asks whose run moved past them
kills: the push dispatcher starts reviews from the one queue on its three triggers never starts a queued review whose pull request moved to a new head, and tells its waiter at once

mutations.name: an aborted step leaves its review queued
kills: the push dispatcher starts reviews from the one queue on its three triggers withdraws a queued review whose step aborts, so the next in line takes the freed slot
